name: Mosaic Texture Storage with Multitexturing
definition: A technique to store 3D volumetric data (slices) in 2D textures by treating the RGBA channels of a 2D texture as four independent single-channel textures, and using multiple texture units (multitexturing) to store additional slices, thereby maximizing GPU texture capacity on platforms lacking 3D texture support.
summary: Mosaic Texture Storage with Multitexturing stores 3D volumetric data in 2D textures by utilizing all RGBA channels and multiple texture units to maximize GPU capacity on devices lacking 3D texture support.
